import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_M = 1000007;
    static final int MAX_N = 210;
    
    static char[][] grid1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] node_id = new int[15][15];
    static int node_count;
    static int source, sink, max_time, size_n;
    static int zero_x, zero_y;
    static final int[] dx = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, reverse_edge;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            reverse_edge = r;
        }
    }
    
    static List<Edge>[] edges = new List[MAX_N * 2];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAX_N];
    static int[] ptr = new int[MAX_N];
    
    static boolean is_valid(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < size_n && y < size_n && grid1[x][y] >= '0' && grid1[x][y] <= '9';
    }
    
    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        edges[u].add(new Edge(v, cap, edges[v].size()));
        edges[v].add(new Edge(u, 0, edges[u].size() - 1));
    }
    
    static void bfs_from(int x, int y) {
        if (grid2[x][y] != '\0') {
            add_edge(node_id[x][y] + node_count, sink, grid2[x][y] - '0');
        }
        if (grid1[x][y] == '0') return;
        
        add_edge(source, node_id[x][y], grid1[x][y] - '0');
        if (grid2[x][y] != '\0') {
            add_edge(node_id[x][y], node_id[x][y] + node_count, 10);
        }
        
        int start_x = x, start_y = y;
        Queue<int[]> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<int[]> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.add(new int[]{x, y});
        qy.add(new int[]{zero_x, zero_y});
        
        int[][] d1 = new int[size_n][size_n];
        int[][] d2 = new int[size_n][size_n];
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(d1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(d2[i], -1);
        }
        d1[x][y] = 0;
        d2[zero_x][zero_y] = 0;
        
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int sz1 = qx.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz1; ++i) {
                int[] cur = qx.poll();
                int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1];
                if (d2[cx][cy] >= 0) continue;
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = cx + dx[k], ny = cy + dy[k];
                    if (is_valid(nx, ny) && d1[nx][ny] == -1) {
                        d1[nx][ny] = d1[cx][cy] + 1;
                        if (d1[nx][ny] > max_time) break;
                        if (d2[nx][ny] >= 0) continue;
                        qx.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                        if (grid2[nx][ny] != '0') {
                            add_edge(node_id[start_x][start_y], node_id[nx][ny] + node_count, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int sz2 = qy.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < sz2; ++i) {
                int[] cur = qy.poll();
                int cx = cur[0], cy = cur[1];
                for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                    int nx = cx + dx[k], ny = cy + dy[k];
                    if (is_valid(nx, ny) && d2[nx][ny] == -1) {
                        d2[nx][ny] = d2[cx][cy] + 1;
                        qy.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean dinic_bfs() {
        Arrays.fill(dist, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(source);
        dist[source] = 0;
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : edges[u]) {
                if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] == -1) {
                    dist[e.to] = dist[u] + 1;
                    q.add(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[sink] != -1;
    }
    
    static int dinic_dfs(int u, int flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < edges[u].size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            Edge e = edges[u].get(i);
            if (e.capacity > 0 && dist[e.to] == dist[u] + 1) {
                int pushed = dinic_dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.capacity -= pushed;
                    edges[e.to].get(e.reverse_edge).capacity += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }
    
    static int max_flow() {
        int result = 0;
        while (dinic_bfs()) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dinic_dfs(source, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (pushed <= 0) break;
                result += pushed;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        size_n = sc.nextInt();
        max_time = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            grid1[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            grid2[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(node_id[i], -1);
        }
        node_count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    zero_x = i;
                    zero_y = j;
                } else if (is_valid(i, j)) {
                    node_id[i][j] = ++node_count;
                }
            }
        }
        
        source = 0;
        sink = 2 * node_count + 1;
        
        for (int i = 0; i < MAX_N * 2; i++) {
            edges[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size_n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size_n; j++) {
                if (is_valid(i, j)) {
                    bfs_from(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(max_flow());
        sc.close();
    }
}
